title: Extending a proper invariant subgroup of a finite primary module
statement: Let ℓ be prime, Q an ℓ-group, V a finite abelian group with a ℤ-linear Q-action ρ and ℓ-primary underlying additive group. Let W be a proper Q-stable additive subgroup. There exists a Q-stable additive subgroup W′ strictly containing W such that ℓ x and ρ(g)x-x belong to W for all x in W′ and g in Q.

source.place: Tag 0GIZ filtration assertion (proof omitted with augmentation-ideal hint); Tag 0GJ0 proof, finite monodromy and Sylow reduction. Agent-written fixed-point/Cauchy proof of the finite primary module case.

proof.text: Take the finite nonzero quotient A=V/W. Primary torsion descends along the surjective quotient map. A nonzero element has order divisible by ℓ, which divides the cardinality of A.

Apply Mathlib IsPGroup.exists_fixed_point_of_prime_dvd_card_of_fixed_point to the Q-action on A and its zero fixed point. Its invariant subgroup I is nonzero and primary. Thus ℓ divides its cardinality. Mathlib exists_prime_addOrderOf_dvd_card′ supplies an element y of order ℓ in I.
The subgroup L of invariants killed by ℓ contains y and is nonzero. Its inverse image W′ strictly contains W. The quotient-map identities imply Q-stability and both requested membership conditions.
